propositions: The code_health lens is Python/rebar-coupled and must be made portable to non-Python client projects via a configurable polyglot code-analyzer.
Existing readers hardcode src/rebar paths, .py LOC, and .github/module-size-limit.txt, which should become per-project config for scan root and size policy.
Missing paths currently fabricate authoritative zeros or leak a raw FileNotFoundError instead of reporting an honest Unavailable.
The analyzer should shell out deterministically to scc, lizard, and jscpd behind an optional [metrics] extra so rebar core gains no new hard dependencies.
When no analyzer is configured for a language or the extra is absent, code_health must return a genuine Unavailable reason, never scan a hardcoded path or fabricate data.
The rebar module-size cap should be re-expressed as an optional policy layered over the generic LOC signal.
